title: Venus high-performance design principles v1
objective: Promote portable optimization thinking and search prompts without promoting backend-specific cycle values, syntax failures or hardware constants.

principles.statement: Start from the fixed-point numerical contract and data dependencies, not from the scalar source control flow. Search for an equivalent formulation around the active backend's vector, complex, mask, shuffle and reduction operations.
principles.falsification: Reject when intermediate widths, rounding, saturation, state or visible checkpoints differ.

principles.statement: Map the largest legal regular dimension—RE, subcarrier, symbol, antenna, layer, code-block element or independent batch—to useful long vectors. Keep scalar work for configuration, address setup and measured irregular tails rather than payload traversal.
principles.falsification: Inspect emitted and dynamic instruction mix; allocation/copy/return vectors around a scalar payload loop do not qualify as vectorization.
source_evidence: PDCCH CCH vector front end and Polar decomposition

principles.statement: Transform static layouts and batch structure to create continuous vector transfers, then use in-register shuffle or masks for rearrangement. Avoid repeated short transfers and scalar gather when layout can make the hot path regular.
principles.falsification: Measure transfer count, instruction mix and integrated cycles; reject a layout that only moves cost to another DAG stage.

principles.statement: Before shrinking useful vector length or spilling, delay claims, end temporary lifetimes early, reuse dead vectors, reduce retained outputs and inspect compiler-created temporaries.
principles.falsification: Use row/liveness estimates plus compile probes; a compiler failure is a scoped counterexample, not proof that the intrinsic or all wide vectors are unsupported.

principles.statement: Treat barriers and other serialization as optimization candidates by dependency class. Remove one class at a time, compare every checkpoint, and retain only measured correctness-required boundaries.
principles.falsification: The first intermediate mismatch rejects the candidate even if final output occasionally matches; fewer barriers alone is not a performance claim.

principles.statement: When a hot runtime control has a small frozen legal domain, test generated per-value specialization, fixed expansion and static precomputation while preserving a complete configuration matrix and an explicit fallback or rejection boundary.
principles.falsification: Reject branch drift, excessive code/live pressure or any configuration-specific golden mismatch; rank only same-matrix measurements.

principles.statement: Profile the complete DAG critical path, data movement, parallel scheduling, task boundaries and temporary lifetimes. Fusion, splitting and stage movement are hypotheses whose value must be remeasured after integration.
principles.falsification: A faster isolated replay does not qualify when integrated cycles regress or an exposed intermediate changes.

principles.statement: Change one falsifiable hypothesis per candidate. Build independently, run Gem5 fast, compare all visible outputs, rank only same-key correct candidates, verify the integrated winner, and send only that winner to fresh immutable RTL.
principles.falsification: Compile success, zero exit status, final CRC alone, source line count or host wall time cannot qualify or rank a candidate.

principles.statement: When Gem5, compiler or RTL diverges, freeze inputs and firmware, locate the first failing checkpoint or event, and reduce it to the smallest positive/negative probe. Reuse only the abstract hypothesis across backends.
principles.falsification: Do not promote a workaround without a scoped counterexample and do not modify RTL or simulator semantics to make one workload pass.

non_transferable_items: compiler-version failure fingerprints as universal bans
evidence_threshold: A general performance prompt requires at least two independent workloads or shape classes; each use begins as an unverified hypothesis on a new backend.

shadow_patch.requirement: Generate exact live-registry/prompt changes only after the principles and applicability boundaries are accepted.

promotion_conditions: Bind every promoted prompt to its applicability and falsification text
Replay at least two evidence families for any prompt making a general effectiveness claim
Do not copy backend-scoped metrics into live portable knowledge
Bind human acceptance to proposal, shadow patch and base digests
source_evidence_policy: Original proposals remain evidence and counterexamples; they do not become live prompts by themselves.
